cards.imageAlt: Figure 35，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at the picture, describe what you can see.
cards.audioTextZh: 看这张图片，描述你看到的内容。
cards.referenceText: A Saudi Arabian Airlines B747 aircraft is parking on the ditch with the nose and nose gear damaged. Some mechanics are standing behind the right engines. There are mountains near the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一架沙特阿拉伯航空公司的波音747飞机正停在沟渠上，机头和前起落架被损坏。一些机械工人正站在飞机右侧引擎后方。机场附近有一些山脉。

cards.audioText: What happened to the aircraft according to your imagination?
cards.audioTextZh: 设想一下这架飞机可能发生了什么事情。
cards.referenceText: The plane was probably in the process of landing or taking off in the bad weather or there were some mechanical troubles with the aircraft, so that it ran out of the runway and skidded into the ditch.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这架飞机可能是恶劣天气时降落或起飞过程中，或者是飞机出现机械故障，所以冲出跑道并滑进了沟渠中。

cards.audioText: What do you think was the reason leading to the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为导致事故的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I guess the runway of this airport was very slippery due to bad weather, and the pilot wanted to reject takeoff but the brake action was so poor with high speed that he could not stop the airplane on the runway. Another possible reason was that there were some mechanical troubles with the aircraft so the pilot lost directional control of the plane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为由于恶劣天气导致机场跑道湿滑，飞行员想要中断起飞，但是飞机的刹车效应差、速度快，飞行员无法令飞机停在跑道上。另一个可能的原因是飞机出现一些机械故障，所以飞行员失去了对飞机的方向控制。

cards.audioText: What factors would affect the takeoff speed required?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会影响起飞速度？
cards.referenceText: The takeoff speed required varies with air density, aircraft gross weight, and aircraft configuration, such as flap and slat position. Takeoff V-speeds, V1, VR and V2 are used to describe the operations with transport aircraft. These speeds are determined also by the length and slope of the runway and any peculiar conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞速度由空气密度、飞机起飞总重和飞机构型（如襟翼和缝翼位置 ）的不同而要求不同。起飞速度，V1、VR和V2用来描述运输机的操作。这些速度同样也由跑道长度、斜度和任何特殊条件决定。

cards.audioText: What aspects are related to the particular landing performance of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机着陆表现与哪些因素相关？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, crosswind, plane size, weight, runway length, obstacles, ground effects, weather, runway altitude, air temperature, air pressure, air traffic control, visibility, avionics, and some other factors would affect a particular landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知的是，侧风、飞机型号和重量、跑道长度、障碍物、地面效应、天气、机场标高、气温、气压、空中管制、可见度、航空电子以及一些其它的因素。

cards.audioText: It is reported that the accident shown in the picture happened during taxiing from a hangar toward a departure gate by a maintenance crew, and they taxied using only the No.1 and No.4 engines. What do you think of that?
cards.audioTextZh: 据报道，图中事故发生时维修人员将飞机从机库滑行至登机口，并且滑行时仅打开1号和4号引擎，你怎么看这件事？
cards.referenceText: Apparently, they didn’t realize that the braking system of aircraft was powered by hydraulic pumps powered by engines 2 and 3, so they couldn’t stop the aircraft in time when it was out of directional control which resulted in the accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 显然他们没有意识到飞机的刹车系统由液压泵驱动，而液压泵由2号和3号引擎驱动，所以他们无法在飞机失去方向控制时停止飞机，从而引发这起事故。
